chain.label: Fire ignites within aft lavatory vanity/amenities section, origin undetermined
Fire-damaged wiring trips the flush motor's three circuit breakers
chain.trigger: the three circuit breakers associated with the aft lavatory's flush motor...tripped in rapid succession

caused_by.evidence: the damage to the wiring which caused the three flush motor circuit breakers to trip was caused by heat and fire

chain.label: Captain misattributes breaker trips to a seized flush motor and defers investigation
chain.trigger: The captain assumed that the flush motor had probably seized and took no further action

caused_by.evidence: the captain immediately made one attempt to reset them; the circuit breakers would not reset

chain.label: Flight attendant and first officer, unable to locate the fire, repeatedly assure captain the smoke is clearing
chain.trigger: flight attendant in charge came to the cockpit and told the captain... 'I think its gonna be easing up'

caused_by.evidence: Neither he nor the first officer told the captain that they had not seen the fire and that they did not know exactly where it was or how intensely it was burning
the tripping of the flush motor's three circuit breakers... was the first abnormal occurrence they noted

chain.label: Captain underestimates the fire's severity and does not order an immediate descent
chain.trigger: I did not decide to descend at this time because, 'I expected it (the fire) to be put out.'

caused_by.evidence: they provided the captain with an inadequate assessment of the fire's severity

chain.label: Captain delays initiating the emergency descent for about 5.5 minutes after being told of the fire
chain.trigger: about 5 minutes 30 seconds elapsed between the time that the No. 2 flight attendant told the captain there was a fire... and his decision to begin the emergency descent

caused_by.evidence: the time to make the decision appears excessive given the circumstances

chain.label: Fire venting through the lavatory vent tube heat-damages the generator feeder cables, tripping both a.c. generators and disabling stabilizer trim and primary flight instruments
chain.trigger: As a result of the heat, faults developed on the left and right generator feeder cables, and... the protective circuits tripped them off the line

caused_by.evidence: The hot gases caused the aluminum vent tube to melt away... and their impingement on the generator feeder cable bundles

chain.label: First officer shuts off the cabin air conditioning/pressurization packs during descent, eliminating the main means of purging smoke
chain.trigger: he turned the air conditioning and pressurization packs off... he thought the packs were feeding the fire

caused_by.evidence: the smoke was getting bad at that point and my reasoning was I have to do something
with the loss of electrical power, the augmentation valve in the pressurization system closed, and high pressure bleed air was not available

chain.label: Flash fire/backdraft erupts through the cabin about 60-90 seconds after doors and exits are opened following landing
chain.trigger: About 60 to 90 seconds after the exits were opened, a flash fire enveloped the airplane interior

caused_by.evidence: with no airflow available to reduce the buildup of heat and combustible gases at the upper levels of the cabin, the onset of factors conducive to flashover or flashfire was accelerated

chain.label: Twenty-three passengers trapped in the smoke-filled cabin are killed in the flash fire; three sustain serious injuries
chain.trigger: Twenty-three passengers perished in the fire

caused_by.evidence: the delayed decision to descend contributed to the severity of the accident
Twenty-three passengers perished in the fire
